bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Snow Leopard: Beyond the Myth Nisar Malik spends two years documenting the daily life of the snow leopard, the most elusive of all cats.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Jaguars: Brazil's Super Cats South America's supreme predator, jaguars are also one of the most elusive animals on the planet; a pioneering team in Brazil tracks individual wild jaguars to gain amazing insight into their lives.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: The Himalayas A documentary looking at the variety of wild animals inhabiting the Himalayas.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Badgers: Secrets of the Sett While badgers are easily recognized, remarkably few people have ever seen one alive; it's a creature blamed for destruction and disease, but surprisingly little is known about the sett society.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Echo Ely and Friends - Africa's Forgotten Elephants This film goes beyond events at the Amboseli National Park, in search of elephants living in Africa's vast landscape.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Florida: America's Animal Paradise Florida is famous for its beaches, blue water and year-round sun, but it also has a surprising wild side; it is home to pine forests, coral reefs and the famous Everglades wetland, the largest subtropical wilderness in the U.S.

bbcearth.us.title: 24 Hours on Earth
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Day The changing position of the sun affects animal and plant behavior; lemurs need morning heat; a chameleon survives on solar power.

bbcearth.us.title: 24 Hours on Earth
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Night The sun's light, reflected in the moon, acts as light for hunting tarsiers and an aphrodisiac for Australian corals.

bbcearth.us.title: Animal Babies
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Safari Babies The great plains of Africa are home to some of the most iconic animals on the planet. Growing up here means safari babies face immense challenges that will really test them.

bbcearth.us.title: Animal Babies
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Water Babies Many animals that live in water come on land to have their babies. Being born this way presents some major challenges for water babies to overcome. For some, simply getting to water in the first place can be the biggest trial of their young lives.

bbcearth.us.title: Animal Babies
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 Mountain Babies Mountains are some of the most challenging places for animals to live. Mountain babies must battle extreme weather and hungry predators. With food difficult to find, they have to work hard for every mouthful.

bbcearth.us.title: Animal Super Senses
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Sight Exploring the extraordinary sense of sight in the animal world; Helen Czerski and Patrick Aryee reveal how caribou use ultraviolet light to avoid wolves.

bbcearth.us.title: Animal Super Senses
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Sound Helen Czerski and Patrick Aryee reveal how alligators use low pitch rumbles to make the water around them dance; they give a herd of elephants a hearing test.

bbcearth.us.title: Animal Super Senses
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 Scent Exploring the world of scent, including animals that have pushed their sense of smell way beyond human abilities; diving into shark-infested waters in the Bahamas.

bbcearth.us.title: Baby Chimp Rescue
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Miracles Can Happen At a home for rescued baby chimps in Liberia, Jim and Jenny Desmond teach the orphans the skills they would have learned from their mothers in the wild; a new orphan named Miracle is rescued from her life on a chain.

bbcearth.us.title: Baby Chimp Rescue
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Breaking Point At Liberia's only home for rescued chimpanzees, there are more new arrivals; Jimmy and Jenny Desmond and their team now have 28 chimps to look after, including an 8-week-old baby called Gaia.

bbcearth.us.title: Baby Chimp Rescue
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 A New Beginning Jimmy and Jenny Desmond and their team are at breaking point, with 38 chimps to look after; losing one of them to illness leaves the team more determined than ever to build them all a new sanctuary where they can live like wild chimps.

bbcearth.us.title: Cats Uncovered
bbcearth.us.description: Liz Bonnin joins forces with some of the world's top cat experts to conduct a groundbreaking study.

bbcearth.us.title: Cats Uncovered
bbcearth.us.description: Liz Bonnin and some of the world's leading cat experts reveal the wild sides of domestic cats; with GPS trackers and cameras, they discover how a cat can transform from pampered pet to purring predator.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 On a misty lagoon in Sardinia Rick watches the fishermen catch mullet using the same methods as the Romans did centuries before. He boards a ferry for Sicily to find, in the heart of Palermo, one of the best pasta dishes he's ever tasted.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Sicily and Puglia Rick travels from Sicily to Puglia.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Corfu Rick departs Italy and makes his way to the Greek island of Corfu, where he attends a family feast; he visits kitchens in restaurants all over the island and learns how to make dishes such as a Greek peasant salad with feta and olives and more.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Mallorca and Catalonia In Mallorca, Rick finds wonderful seafood dishes and the most succulent roast lamb he's ever tasted, while in Barcelona he samples Catalonian food at the famous Boqueria market.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Morocco and Turkey Rick samples the delights of couscous, tagines and mint tea in Moroccan bazaars, before heading along the old silk route to south-eastern Turkey, where he tastes the finest kebabs.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Nisha's family helps her cook chicken dhansak and a Hungarian favorite.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Nisha cooks chicken korma and marinated tandoori monkfish tail on the BBQ.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Nisha cooks a traditional monsoon mushroom curry with grapes and tasty barbecued corn.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Nisha Katona cooks salmon and tomato curry, and eggplant curry with fresh roti.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Nisha cooks oxtail and shin curry, spiced barbecued prawns and banana pudding.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Nisha cooks some Malaysian mussels and ginger biscuit lamb raan.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Nisha cooks meatball curry and tandoori chops with turmeric chips.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 Nisha cooks egg and cauliflower curry and some Hungarian plum dumplings.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E09 Nisha cooks Bengali fish in banana leaves and a big roasted rib of beef.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E10 Nisha cooks chicken and apricot biryani and fish finger sandwiches.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Suffolk and Naples Rick celebrates the abundance of seafood and the rich, colorful sauces of Naples.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 India and Cornwall Rick catches turbot off the Cornish coast and cooks it with cider and cream.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Spain and Britain Rick's off to Galicia in Spain to sample some rare shellfish.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 India and America A spicy shark vindaloo and the making of an authentic dhal with lentils.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Australia and Italy Seafood king Rick travels to Queensland, Australia.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 America and Cornwall Chesapeake Bay in the U.S., cooking traditional oyster dishes.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Thailand and Cornwall Rick goes to Hua Hin in Thailand, where he spends time in local markets talking to locals about various types of food; in Cornwall, he fries fish and jazzes it up with red curry and steamed jasmine rice.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 America and Yorkshire Rick visits America, Naples and the UK in Whitby, with good old English fish and chips in the final episode.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Sweet and Sour Nigel Slater shows us how to prepare five different sweet and sour dishes.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Fish and Meat Nigel continues to explore successful food marriages in the kitchen.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Spicy and Cool Nigel Slater shows us how to mix spicy flavors with something cooling.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S09 E04 Palm Springs and Tiffany Rings Sandoval goes the extra mile to help Schwartz produce his fertility specimen, while Lala expresses concerns to Scheana over Brock's sordid past; James and Raquel host a family engagement dinner.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S09 E05 Drink the Tea, Spill the Tea James encourages Raquel to confront her biggest bully, while Katie and Schwartz consult a fertility doctor about their chances of conceiving.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S09 E06 Poker Faces Lala comes under fire during a girls' night; Brock must answer to Lisa Vanderpump after the darkness in his past is revealed; Raquel takes James to a boxing class to work on his anger; Randall hosts a poker night for the guys.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S09 E07 Anger Mismanagement Schwartz and Sandoval brainstorm ideas for their bar, while Raquel comes clean to Lisa about the story behind her nose job, much to James' dismay; Charli excludes Lala from her party in solidarity with Scheana.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S09 E08 Pitch Not-So-Perfect Katie makes a splash at Schwartz and Sandoval's pitch meeting, much to Sandoval's dismay, while Ariana coaches Raquel on how to set boundaries with James; Lala finally makes amends with Scheana after their rift.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S09 E09 It's a Mad, Mad Pool Party Scheana struggles with her post-baby body, while James sets a new goal for himself as his two-year sobriety anniversary approaches; Ariana and Sandoval throw a pool party; Sandoval and Katie clash over the future of the bar; Lala confronts Schwartz.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S09 E10 Sexy Unique Feet Ariana, Katie and Charli get creative with a photoshoot to help raise money for Raquel's second nose job; Scheana gets annoyed at James for refusing to help out with Brock's fitness app; Schwartz must pay up when he loses a bet to Lisa Vanderpump.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S09 E11 Best Friends for Never Sandoval plans a mysterious surprise for Ariana's 36th birthday, while Katie seeks advice from Lisa after a blowout fight at TomTom; Brock encourages Scheana to stick up for herself with Charli.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S09 E12 Give Them Lala Katie and Ariana become business partners; Lala celebrates her fiscal independence by throwing a party; James battles his controlling impulses as Raquel's sister suggests a bachelorette party for the future bride.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S09 E13 Unprogress Party Schwartz and Sandoval throw a progress party to show off their new bar to their friends; Lisa, Ariana and Katie brainstorm ideas for their sandwich shop; Scheana embraces signing a prenuptial; Brock's attempt to hold James accountable backfires.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S09 E14 Between a Brock and a Hard Place Ariana and Katie meet with Randall about investing in their sandwich shop, while Sandoval gets cold feet about helping Brock with his latest scheme to marry Scheana; the gang heads north to a beautiful winery in Santa Ynez.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S09 E15 Engagement Party Crashers On the eve of Raquel and James' engagement party, Scheana and Brock make a big announcement that sends shock waves through their friend group, and Sandoval confronts Lisa about her lack of support for the Toms' new bar.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S10 E01 Breaking Bubbas Katie and Schwartz attempt to maintain a friendship in the wake of their recent divorce; James introduces his new girlfriend, Ally, to the rest of the group; tensions between Schwartz and Lala bubble over when one of them commits an act of betrayal.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S10 E02 Was It Worth It? Raquel cozies up to Peter in an attempt to get over James; Lala opens up about the origins of her last relationship; James throws Raquel under the bus to Lisa; Katie comes face to face with the bar that led to the demise of her marriage.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S10 E03 Troll Mates Lala drops a bombshell on Raquel that shakes the foundation of their newfound friendship; Sandoval takes some time away from the bar to play rock star with his cover band; Ariana and Katie take the next step in opening their sandwich shop.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S10 E04 No Home Left to Wreck James finds himself at the center of the rumor mill when he gets kicked out of a nightclub while fighting with Ally; Katie tries to keep her ex in line with another ultimatum; Tom and Tom host a friends-and-family event at Schwartz and Sandy's.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S10 E05 Lovestruck at the Discopussy Katie plans a divorce party trip to Las Vegas and Lake Havasu but conveniently leaves Scheana off the guest list; Lala and Raquel find themselves flirting with the same guy; Ariana receives devastating news from home.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S10 E06 Divorce Party Crashers Lala and Katie freak out at Raquel for making out with Oliver; Scheana plans a guy's night to help Schwartz get back in the game; Tom and Tom weigh a big decision about the future of their bar; Lisa consoles Ariana about her loss.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S10 E07 Galaxy Gaslighting James starts to spiral when he feels that his friends are choosing Raquel over him; Lala breaks her years-long dry spell when she hooks up with a new guy; Katie and Scheana clash over a hotel room snafu.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S10 E08 By Invitation Only Lisa and Ariana plan a surprise bridal shower for Scheana; James makes it his mission to score Ally an invitation to the wedding; Raquel and Schwartz take their flirting to the next level; the group travels to Cancun to celebrate Brock and Scheana.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S10 E09 Forbidden Fruit Katie and Schwartz celebrate a milestone in their breakup with an extravagant dinner that quickly goes south; Scheana erupts on Lala for skipping wedding events to avoid Raquel; James must atone for his behavior when his temper gets the best of him.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S10 E10 It's All Happening ... Again Scheana and Brock marry in a lavish ceremony in Cancun; James and Katie must sort through their feelings after their exes hook up with one another; Lisa attempts to solve the Toms' problems; Lala puts Raquel in her place.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S10 E11 Mistress in Distress Back in Los Angeles, Lala celebrates her birthday with an epic party; Raquel sets her sights on Oliver after being rejected by Schwartz; Tom and Ariana discuss their plans to make embryos together; Ally and James witness a suspicious interaction.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S10 E12 Beach, Don't Kill My Vibe Sandoval opens up to Schwartz about his romantic problems with Ariana; Scheana blames Katie for spreading a sordid rumor about some of their friends; Ariana suffers another big loss; James plans an epic beach day that takes a turn for the worse.

cinevault.us.title: The Karate Kid
cinevault.us.description: Daniel (Ralph Macchio) moves to Southern California with his mother, Lucille (Randee Heller), but quickly finds himself the target of a group of bullies who study karate at the Cobra Kai dojo. Fortunately, Daniel befriends Mr. Miyagi (Noriyuki "Pat" Morita), an unassuming repairman who just happens to be a martial arts master himself. Miyagi takes Daniel under his wing, training him in a more compassionate form of karate and preparing him to compete against the brutal Cobra Kai. (Drama, Martial arts, Movie) - 1984-06-22

cinevault.us.title: The Karate Kid Part II
cinevault.us.description: After learning that his father is dying, karate master Mr. Miyagi (Noriyuki "Pat" Morita) returns home to Okinawa, bringing his protégé, Daniel, with him. In Japan, Miyagi is surprised to discover that his old sweetheart, Yukie, has remained single. Meanwhile, Daniel is attracted to Yukie's niece, Kumiko. But romance must be put on hold while Daniel and Miyagi deal with local bullies and long-harbored grudges. (Drama, Martial arts, Movie) - 1986-06-20

cinevault.us.title: The Karate Kid Part III
cinevault.us.description: Cobra Kai karate instructor John Kreese (Martin Kove) is still brooding over the defeat handed to him by Daniel LaRusso (Ralph Macchio) and Mr. Miyagi (Noriyuki "Pat" Morita). With his slimy partner, Terry Silver (Thomas Ian Griffith), Kreese plans an intricate payback that involves hiring a mean-spirited ringer (Sean Kanan) to rob Daniel of his championship title. When Mr. Miyagi refuses to train Daniel, even under threat, the boy makes the mistake of turning to Terry for guidance. (Action, Dark comedy, Drama, Martial arts, Movie) - 1989-07-27

cinevault.us.title: The Next Karate Kid
cinevault.us.description: Karate master Mr. Miyagi goes to Boston to attend a military reunion. There, he visits with Louisa, the widow of his former commander, and meets her granddaughter, Julie. Julie's parents were recently killed in a car accident, and she is still reeling from the loss. When Julie surprises Miyagi with her knowledge of karate, he takes her to a Buddhist monastery for training and to help her come to terms with her angst. (Drama, Family, Martial arts, Movie) - 1994-12-17

cinevault.us.title: Ice Castles

cinevault.us.title: Crossroads
cinevault.us.description: A guitar student (Ralph Macchio) tours the Deep South with an old blues man (Joe Seneca), chasing a lost song written by Robert Johnson. (Drama, Movie, Music, Romance) - 1986

cinevault.us.title: Lost & Found
cinevault.us.description: Sent to spend the summer with their uncle on a remote island, young brothers, Andy (Justin Kelly) and Mark (Benjamin Stockham), learn that their eccentric grandfather once owned the island but vanished without a trace, taking with him the secret to a vast fortune. Delving into the mysterious past of the island, the brothers discover that their grandfather designed a complex treasure hunt, a hunt that could lead to unimaginable wealth and heal their broken family. (Adventure, Drama, Movie, Mystery) - 2016-02-22

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Going All the Way
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war. (Drama) - 1997

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Getaway
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive. (Action, Adventure, Crime drama, Thriller) - 1994

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: I'm Charlie Walker
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him. (Drama) - 2022

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Long Walk Home
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better. (Historical drama) - 1990

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Jack's Back
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn. (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama) - 1988

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief. (Romantic comedy, Comedy, Crime drama, Romance) - 2008

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Gang of Roses
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew. (Western, Action) - 2003

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Chef
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love. (Comedy drama) - 2014

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Just Getting Started

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E01 "Fifth Gear" quite literally takes to new heights by staging a race between cars and planes.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E02 Tom Ford is testing the opulent £225,000 Bentley Azure with some help from film director Michael Winner; Jonny Smith tries to drive coast-to-coast using chip fat as fuel.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E03 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out if the Lotus Elise S is the best track car for novices; Le Mans winner Guy Smith races the fastest van on sale today.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E04 Jon Bentley investigates how hitting a motorway crash barrier can make your car fly through the air. Jason Plato gives cricketer Kevin Pietersen the chance to drive the Lamborghini Gallardo Spyder.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E05 Jason drives the impressive 500bhp Ford Shelby GT500; Tiff races Mitsubishi's Evo 9 FQ360 against a former Red Arrow pilot's stunt plane.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E06 Vicki Butler-Henderson drives the one-off supercharged Nissan Murano GTC; Jonny Smith challenges the big lawnmower to a head to head in a grass cutting contest.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E07 Jason drives the Subaru Litchfield Type 25; Tiff drives the Ferrari 599 on the world's most treacherous roads.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E08 Tom Ford drives Volvo's stylish new coupe, the C30; Tiff Needell tests whether a green supercar really can be fun in Lotus' biofuel powered Exige 265E.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E09 Vicki Butler-Henderson has a mini-moto race against some of the big names in bike racing; Tom Ford tests the new Land Rover Freelander on Britain's remote school run.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E10 Tom Ford's been testing the Mazda's new MX5 Roadster Coupe; Vicki Butler-Henderson has been thrashing Porsche's 911 GT3.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E11 Vicki is taught how to drive a car on two wheels; Jonny visits Germany for some extreme airbag testing.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E12 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out if an old Daihatsu Charade is the toughest car you can buy; Tom Ford drives the Honda CRV, the SUV that claims to be greener than a Mini Cooper.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E13 The winners of the Fifth Gear Awards 2006; prizes for Best Small Car, Best Family Car, Best Fast Car and the overall Car of the Year.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E01 Vicki Butler-Henderson takes the new Fiat Panda 100HP for a spin around the track - against a Ferrari; Tiff Needell hits Las Vegas to try out Audi's first supercar, the R8.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E02 Vicki Butler-Henderson risks life and limb in the most dangerous car stunt of all, driving a car under a moving lorry; Jonny Smith tests the new Mercedes C Class and its revolutionary seat design.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E03 Tiff Needell employs the help of two models to test the theory that the quicker you drive a convertible, the less your hair blows. He blasts the brand new Bentley Continental GTC up to 150mph.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E04 Vicki Butler-Henderson makes an unprecedented attempt to hit 200mph in an A1 Grand Prix car; Tom Ford and Jonny Smith take the seven newest hot hatches on sale and decide which is best.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E05 Jonny Smith goes on a rather expensive road trip - in a £250,000 Rolls-Royce Phantom; Tom Ford is testing the new Porsche Cayenne Turbo.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E06 Jason drives the Aston Martin V8 Vantage Roadster, Jonny tests the car James Bond drove in Casino Royale.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E07 Tom Ford tests the latest version of the car that is perennially voted one of Britain's favourite cars - the Land Rover Defender; Jonny Smith celebrates Ferrari's 60th Birthday.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E08 Tom Ford and Jonny Smith enter a demolition derby in two unlikely vehicles, Reliant Robins; Tiff Needell tests the latest Porsche 911, the GT3RS; Vicki Butler-Henderson drives the new Vauxhall VXR8.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E09 Vicki Butler-Henderson tests the latest BMW X5 4.8i; it's an impressive machine, costing £50,000, it does 150mph; Jason Plato tests the ultimate track car, the brand-new Lotus 2 Eleven.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E10 Tom spends the day with the scourge of modern day motorists: wheel clampers; Vicki tests the Nissan 350Z.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E02 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out if the new 207 GTI is as exhilarating to drive as the 20-year-old hot hatch, the 205 GTI; Fifth Gear conducts a fascinating world's first crash test - we crash a 15-year-old Volvo 940.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E03 Diesel Mini vs a gas one; comparing the new Subaru Impreza to a previous version.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E04 Checking police driving skills on a racetrack; testing small economy cars on one of Britain's biggest hills.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E06 The BMW Z4 and Nissan 350Z go head-to-head on the track.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E07 Naming which TV cop car is fastest; celebrating the 75th anniversary of the Deuce Coupe; testing the Gumpert Apollo; building a drift car.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E08 Tiff Needell gets behind the wheel of the cutting-edge Ferrari 430 Scuderia.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E09 A Lamborghini Gallardo Superleggera; a cider farmer who uses rotten apples to produce methane that powers his Jaguar.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E10 Iwan Thomas accepts a stunt challenge from precision driver Russ Swift; Jonny Smith secretly repairs potholes; Tom Ford drives a Monster.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E01 Vicki tests two cars, the Lotus Exige S vs. Caterham CSR; Tom visits Spain to drive the Toyota Land Cruiser; Jason Plato drives the Mercedes CLK63 Black; Tiff teaches Heston Blumenthal the art of power sliding.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E02 Tom gets an advance look at Formula 1 supremo Bernie Ecclestone's rare and unusual collection of cars; Tiff and Jason take the BMW M3 and the Mercedes C63 AMG to a circuit to determine which is most deserving of its £50,000 price tag.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E03 Vicki finds out which is quickest, an old Vauxhall against a new one; Jonny Smith and Tom Ford contest one of motor sport's oldest and most grueling events, the Exeter Trial; Tiff Needell goes to France to drive the new Audi A3 Cabriolet.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E04 Vicki tests the Mercedes Vito X or the VW Transporter Sportline on the track to find out which is quickest; Jonny embarks on the 600-mile transcontinental trip in the BMW 635d; Tom drives the ultimate 4x4, the 12-ton, 10-foot tall Unimog.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E05 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out which is the fastest, the Renault Twingo GT or the Fiat Panda 100HP; Tiff Needell and Jason Plato go head-to-head; this time it's small coupes as the Porsche Cayman comes up against the new BMW 135i Coupe.

During the racially charged summer of 1971, Atwater and Ellis come together to co-chair a community summit on the desegregation of schools in Durham, N.C. The ensuing debate and battle soon lead to surprising revelations that change both of their lives forever. (Historical drama, Movie) - 2019-04-05

moviesphere.us.title: Silver Linings Playbook
moviesphere.us.description: After losing his job and wife, and spending time in a mental institution, Pat Solatano winds up living with his parents. He wants to rebuild his life and reunite with his wife, but his parents would be happy if he just shared their obsession with the Philadelphia Eagles. Things get complicated when Pat meets Tiffany, who offers to help him reconnect with his wife, if he will do something very important for her in exchange. (Comedy, Drama, Movie, Romance) - 2012-11-16

moviesphere.us.title: The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent

Things take a wildly unexpected turn when a CIA operative recruits Cage for an unusual mission. Taking on the role of a lifetime, he soon finds himself channeling his most iconic and beloved characters to save himself and his loved ones. (Action, Comedy, Movie) - 2022-03-12

moviesphere.us.title: Bangkok Dangerous
moviesphere.us.description: Remorseless assassin Joe (Nicolas Cage) is in Thailand to complete a series of contract killings for a crime boss called Surat (Nirattisai Kaljaruek). He hires a street punk named Kong (Shahkrit Yamnam) to run errands for him, all the while planning to kill the youth at the conclusion of his assignment. Instead, Joe becomes Kong's unlikely mentor,and begins a tentative romance with a local shop girl. But as Joe begins to let his guard down, Surat decides it is time to clean house. (Action, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2008-08-22

moviesphere.us.title: Bad Moms
moviesphere.us.description: Amy (Mila Kunis) has a great husband, overachieving children, beautiful home and successful career. Unfortunately, she's also overworked, exhausted and ready to snap. Fed up, she joins forces with two other stressed-out mothers (Kristen Bell, Kathryn Hahn) to get away from daily life and conventional responsibilities. As the gals go wild with their newfound freedom, they set themselves up for the ultimate showdown with PTA queen bee Gwendolyn and her clique of seemingly perfect moms. (Comedy, Movie) - 2016-07-28

paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

Each episode of this series investigates a compelling theory by opening these and other files. After acquiring new information, the show's team of specialists re-examines faulty assumptions, looks for inconsistencies and explores new leads in an attempt to get to the bottom of each case. Just make sure you have your tin foil handy when watching the show. (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

paranormalfiles.us.title: The Conspiracy Show
paranormalfiles.us.description: Many believe that there are things in this world that aren't made public that the average person isn't supposed to know about. The truth may be hidden, but there are some people, like host Richard Syrett, who investigate these conspiracies and try to uncover the secrets. "The Conspiracy Show" examines claims of supernatural creatures, political cover-ups, medical discoveries, extraterrestrial life, paranormal phenomena and other unexplained mysteries. Using interviews with top researchers, skeptics, independent thinkers and authors, Syrett is determined to uncover the truth to some of the most extraordinary claims of conspiracy. (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2011-02-18

paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

shadesofblack.us.title: The Last Letter
shadesofblack.us.description: Catherine Wright struggles with a debilitating sleep disorder. Her husband Michael struggles to cope when their newborn son lies awake. (Thriller) - 2012

shadesofblack.us.title: Chaos
shadesofblack.us.description: A veteran detective is teamed with a rookie cop when they are sent to negotiate with a bunch of criminals holding a bank hostage. It transpires that a master thief has planted a computer virus that will drain funds from the bank's accounts. The detective faces a race against time to catch the thief and stop the randomly evolving computer virus, which models its behavior on the bewildering principles of chaos theory. (Action, Crime drama, Thriller) - 2005

shadesofblack.us.title: Zulu
shadesofblack.us.description: Three South African cops (Orlando Bloom, Forest Whitaker, Conrad Kemp) investigate the drug-related murder of a young woman. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2013

shadesofblack.us.title: Original Gangstas
shadesofblack.us.description: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence. (Action) - 1996

shadesofblack.us.title: Soda Cracker
shadesofblack.us.description: A Chicago police officer practices his own brand of justice to take down the killers who murdered his partner. (Crime drama) - 1989

shadesofblack.us.title: Holiday Heart
shadesofblack.us.description: After losing his police officer lover, Christian drag queen Holiday Heart (Ving Rhames) meets 12-year-old Niki (Jessika Quynn Reynolds) and her drug-addicted mother, Wanda (Alfre Woodard). Heart finds relief from heartache and a renewed sense of purpose when he steps in as a father figure to Niki and welcomes the two women into his life. But when Wanda becomes romantically involved with her drug dealer, Silas, it may endanger Niki and threaten to destroy the makeshift family. (Drama, LGBTQ) - 2000

shadesofblack.us.title: Addicted
shadesofblack.us.description: Successful businesswoman Zoe Reynard (Sharon Leal) seems to have a charmed life. She has a wonderful, loving husband (Boris Kodjoe), two beautiful children and a thriving career. However, as perfect as her life might look to other people, Zoe is secretly tormented by nymphomania. Her need for constant sexual gratification leads her into a secretive existence -- one that, ultimately, may put her family, career and life on the line. Based on a novel by Zane. (Drama, Thriller) - 2014

shadesofblack.us.title: Reasonable Doubt
shadesofblack.us.description: A prosecutor (Dominic Cooper) commits a fatal hit-and-run, then manipulates the case so that the man who was arrested for the crime is acquitted. After the trial, he discovers that his actions have freed a guilty man. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 2014

shadesofblack.us.title: The Best of Enemies
shadesofblack.us.description: The true story of the unlikely relationship between Ann Atwater, an outspoken civil rights activist, and C.P. Ellis, a local Ku Klux Klan leader. During the racially charged summer of 1971, Atwater and Ellis come together to co-chair a community summit on the desegregation of schools in Durham, N.C. The ensuing debate and battle soon lead to surprising revelations that change both of their lives forever. (Historical drama) - 2019

shadesofblack.us.title: In the Heat of the Night: Give Me Your Life
shadesofblack.us.description: As Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) and Harriet prepare to leave for their honeymoon, Forbes (Carl Weathers) clashes with a charismatic cult leader (Peter Fonda) who has arrived in Sparta. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1994

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S36 E09 Double Agents: Lady Vengeance One agent is called out after trying to appease both her alliance and her new group of friends; T.J. forces the agents to participate in his favorite game; old grudges resurface as two rivals go head-to-head.

truehistory.us.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA - How Genograms Reveal Your Ancestry
truehistory.us.description: A genogram is a graphic tool used to explore family history and relationships over a two- to three-generation period, discovering the powerful information that can be conveyed through a genogram as opposed to the traditional family tree diagram. (Educational, Science) - 2021-08-13

truehistory.us.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA - Gaining Insight Through Your Genetics
truehistory.us.description: Exploring the issue of birth assisted by reproductive technologies by meeting Maria, who learns as a teenager that she was born with the help of intrauterine insemination; considering how this knowledge affects an adolescent's identity. (Educational, Science) - 2021-08-13

truehistory.us.title: Alexander the Great and the Hellenistic Age - Greeks and Macedonians
truehistory.us.description: Philip II of Macedon sets the stage for the rise of his son, Alexander the Great, by conquering Greece; when Alexander invades the Persian territory of Asia Minor in 334 B.C., he embarks on the greatest career of conquest the world has ever seen. (Educational, History) - 2000-04-24

truehistory.us.title: Alexander the Great and the Hellenistic Age - Alexander the Divine?
truehistory.us.description: After only two battles, Alexander commands more land than any Greek before him; he orders the Persian emperor to address him as an equal; at the height of his power, he visits Egypt, where he assumes the title of pharaoh and is hailed as a deity. (Educational, History) - 2000-04-24

truehistory.us.title: Alexander the Great and the Hellenistic Age - The Blazing Star
truehistory.us.description: Whether his Egyptian sojourn convinces Alexander that he is a god or just teaches him the political value of blurring the lines between human and divine; how Alexander brings the Persian emperor to battle as he resumes his drive eastward. (Educational, History) - 2000-04-24

truehistory.us.title: Alexander the Great and the Hellenistic Age - Alexander-Myth and Reality
truehistory.us.description: Alexander has an effect on the political development of the eastern Mediterranean; opinions about him remain deeply divided, both in antiquity and the current day; whether one can discern the historical Alexander, or the myth has swallowed the man. (Educational, History) - 2000-04-24

truehistory.us.title: Alexander the Great and the Hellenistic Age - The Formation of the Kingdoms
truehistory.us.description: A generation of warfare among Alexander's successors splits his empire; after these "wars of the Diadochi", three major Hellenistic kingdoms emerge under the control of Alexander's former officers. (Educational, History) - 2000-04-24

truehistory.us.title: Alexander the Great and the Hellenistic Age - Egypt Under the Early Ptolemies
truehistory.us.description: Ptolemy, one of Alexander's companions, transforms himself into a new pharaoh in Egypt even as he remains separate from the conquered Egyptians; how Ptolemy and his successors blend Pharaonic and Macedonian practices to create a new kingdom. (Educational, History) - 2000-04-24

truehistory.us.title: Alexander the Great and the Hellenistic Age - Alexandria and the Library
truehistory.us.description: Alexandria is the seat of Ptolemy's court; the city's library and museum are the premier cultural institutions of the Hellenistic world; and whether Alexandria is a blend of Greek and Egyptian elements or the imposition of one culture over the other. (Educational, History) - 2000-04-24

truehistory.us.title: Alexander the Great and the Hellenistic Age - The Seleucid Realm
truehistory.us.description: The second great Hellenistic kingdom is ruled by the Seleucid dynasty, which builds cities from Syria to Iran, learning how the Seleucids rule a kingdom that stretches across all of Central Asia. (Educational, History) - 2000-04-24

truehistory.us.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA - Your Ancestry, Your Identity
truehistory.us.description: Asking whether genes determine one's essential nature and identity, or one builds their own identity; exploring the essentialist and constructed philosophies; how one might incorporate aspects of both into their own view of personal identity. (Educational, Science) - 2021-08-13

truehistory.us.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA - What Genetic Testing Brings to Ancestry
truehistory.us.description: Labs that provide DNA ancestry information use hundreds of thousands of ancestry-information markers, or AIMs; learning about the AIMs that relate to major identifiable lineages; what can be gleaned from mitochondrial DNA and Y-DNA. (Educational, Science) - 2021-08-13

truehistory.us.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA - Sensitive Approaches to Ancestry Results
truehistory.us.description: There are many social issues affecting an individual's emotional response to receiving DNA ancestry results; how the reciprocal engagement method can help families face unexpected ancestry results; tips to consider before ordering one's own test. (Educational, Science) - 2021-08-13

truehistory.us.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA - When Family Narrative Meets Genetic Testing
truehistory.us.description: People want a family narrative, whereas DNA just "wants" to move itself forward and is neutral on issues of race, subterfuge or social connection; how to create a strategic family narrative to incorporate the scientific facts of DNA ancestry results. (Educational, Science) - 2021-08-13

truehistory.us.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA - Privacy Versus Connection in DNA Testing

truehistory.us.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA - The DNA Discussion Project Research

truehistory.us.title: Alexander the Great and the Hellenistic Age - Alexander-Myth and Reality
truehistory.us.description: Alexander has an effect on the political development of the eastern Mediterranean; opinions about him remain deeply divided, both in antiquity and the current day; whether one can discern the historical Alexander, or the myth has swallowed the man. (Educational, History) - 2000-04-24

truehistory.us.title: Alexander the Great and the Hellenistic Age - The Formation of the Kingdoms
truehistory.us.description: A generation of warfare among Alexander's successors splits his empire; after these "wars of the Diadochi", three major Hellenistic kingdoms emerge under the control of Alexander's former officers. (Educational, History) - 2000-04-24

truehistory.us.title: Alexander the Great and the Hellenistic Age - Egypt Under the Early Ptolemies
truehistory.us.description: Ptolemy, one of Alexander's companions, transforms himself into a new pharaoh in Egypt even as he remains separate from the conquered Egyptians; how Ptolemy and his successors blend Pharaonic and Macedonian practices to create a new kingdom. (Educational, History) - 2000-04-24

truehistory.us.title: Alexander the Great and the Hellenistic Age - Alexandria and the Library
truehistory.us.description: Alexandria is the seat of Ptolemy's court; the city's library and museum are the premier cultural institutions of the Hellenistic world; and whether Alexandria is a blend of Greek and Egyptian elements or the imposition of one culture over the other. (Educational, History) - 2000-04-24

truehistory.us.title: Alexander the Great and the Hellenistic Age - The Seleucid Realm
truehistory.us.description: The second great Hellenistic kingdom is ruled by the Seleucid dynasty, which builds cities from Syria to Iran, learning how the Seleucids rule a kingdom that stretches across all of Central Asia. (Educational, History) - 2000-04-24

truehistory.us.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA - Your Ancestry, Your Identity
truehistory.us.description: Asking whether genes determine one's essential nature and identity, or one builds their own identity; exploring the essentialist and constructed philosophies; how one might incorporate aspects of both into their own view of personal identity. (Educational, Science) - 2021-08-13

truehistory.us.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA - What Genetic Testing Brings to Ancestry
truehistory.us.description: Labs that provide DNA ancestry information use hundreds of thousands of ancestry-information markers, or AIMs; learning about the AIMs that relate to major identifiable lineages; what can be gleaned from mitochondrial DNA and Y-DNA. (Educational, Science) - 2021-08-13

truehistory.us.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA - Sensitive Approaches to Ancestry Results
truehistory.us.description: There are many social issues affecting an individual's emotional response to receiving DNA ancestry results; how the reciprocal engagement method can help families face unexpected ancestry results; tips to consider before ordering one's own test. (Educational, Science) - 2021-08-13

truehistory.us.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA - When Family Narrative Meets Genetic Testing
truehistory.us.description: People want a family narrative, whereas DNA just "wants" to move itself forward and is neutral on issues of race, subterfuge or social connection; how to create a strategic family narrative to incorporate the scientific facts of DNA ancestry results. (Educational, Science) - 2021-08-13

truehistory.us.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA - Privacy Versus Connection in DNA Testing
truehistory.us.description: From the case of Henrietta Lacks to that of the Hagahai people of Papua New Guinea, scientists and government agencies have a history of bad actions with respect to biological samples; learn about the laws and programs in place to protect privacy. (Educational, Science) - 2021-08-13

truehistory.us.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA - The DNA Discussion Project Research
truehistory.us.description: Learning about the DNA Discussion Project and its goals; current results regarding the ways in which DNA ancestry tests are changing identity; looking at questions about unanticipated results, sharing DNA ancestry results and social implications. (Educational, Science) - 2021-08-13

truehistory.us.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA - How Genograms Reveal Your Ancestry
truehistory.us.description: A genogram is a graphic tool used to explore family history and relationships over a two- to three-generation period, discovering the powerful information that can be conveyed through a genogram as opposed to the traditional family tree diagram. (Educational, Science) - 2021-08-13

truehistory.us.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA - Gaining Insight Through Your Genetics
truehistory.us.description: Exploring the issue of birth assisted by reproductive technologies by meeting Maria, who learns as a teenager that she was born with the help of intrauterine insemination; considering how this knowledge affects an adolescent's identity. (Educational, Science) - 2021-08-13

truehistory.us.title: Alexander the Great and the Hellenistic Age - Greeks and Macedonians
truehistory.us.description: Philip II of Macedon sets the stage for the rise of his son, Alexander the Great, by conquering Greece; when Alexander invades the Persian territory of Asia Minor in 334 B.C., he embarks on the greatest career of conquest the world has ever seen. (Educational, History) - 2000-04-24

truehistory.us.title: Alexander the Great and the Hellenistic Age - Alexander the Divine?
truehistory.us.description: After only two battles, Alexander commands more land than any Greek before him; he orders the Persian emperor to address him as an equal; at the height of his power, he visits Egypt, where he assumes the title of pharaoh and is hailed as a deity. (Educational, History) - 2000-04-24

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Italian Job
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred start their road trip in Gino's homeland of Italy, where Gino needs help to pull off an event that is close to his heart. Gino collects Gordon and Fred in a campervan to begin a road trip they won't be forgetting in a hurry. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The French Connection
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to France, where Fred has been asked to co-host an Oyster Festival in the beautiful Arcachon Bay, in just four days' time. Reunited with their campervan, Fred nominates himself as the driver in his homeland. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Tasty Ant Eggs in Ninh Binh
tastemadetravel.us.description: After a long trip from Hue, Luke finally gets some rest in the scenic Ninh Bihn. Tag along as Luke meets with a local rice farmer, takes a canoe out for some crab hunting, and ventures deep into the jungle in search of a local delicacy- red ant eggs! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-24

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Searching For The Banh Da Noodle in Hai Phong
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke is in northern Vietnam- Hai Phong! This is the birthplace of his partner Lynne. Join Luke as he meets some of Lynne's family for the first time, and tries the delicious Banh Da Noodle- a tasty dish that Hai Phong is renowned for! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-31

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Delicious Bun Cha in Hanoi
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke's penultimate stop on his train journey is Hanoi. Follow Luke on his hunt for an iconic Hanoi dish, Bun Cha. Luke takes a ride on the Reunification Express railway, and visits the famous Hoan Kiem Lake for some delicious magenta sticky rice. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-04-07

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Sipping Gin in Sapa
tastemadetravel.us.description: Nearing the end of his Vietnamese journey, Luke stops in Sapa, a hilltop region that he remembers from his travels fifteen years ago. Join Luke as he rekindles a friendship from his previous visit and learns about a local dish of dried buffalo. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-04-14

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Secret Family Recipies in Ho Chi Minh
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke searches to find Ho Chi Minh's old markets before they disappear due to District 1's rapid development. Join Luke as he gathers fresh ingredients from a local market, tries some traditional delicacies, and follows his sweet tooth to Marou. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-02-04

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Vietnamese Pizza in Dalat
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke's next stop is the destination of Dalat. Follow Luke as he visits the Art Deco Dalat Train Station, experiences the French influence of the region with a father and son chef duo, and discovers why Dalat is known as the "Land of Eternal Spring"! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-02-17

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Mamma Mia! Off We Go Again
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to Greece to immerse themselves in the culinary traditions. The taste buddies go island-hopping, keen to learn more about the Mediterranean diet and how the country has one of the healthiest populations in the world. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke arrives in Saigon for a breakfast of iced coffee with condensed milk and a vermicelli noodle dish. Later, he visits his favorite Pho restaurant, then cooks up some spicy Chili Crab Claws. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia - Bangkok's Night Market
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke continues his street food journey in Bangkok where he searches for the best Tom Yum soup and entertains the locals with a rare Thai delicacy. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia - Malaysian Flying Noodles and Pork Bone Soup
tastemadetravel.us.description: In Kuala Lumpur, Luke meets the famous Mr Hung with a reputation for flying instant noodles and Mr Sou who cooks a hearty Pork Bone Soup with medicinal herbal properties. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia - Jakarta's King of Street Food
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke continues his street food adventure exploring Jakarta, a melting pot of diverse cultural cuisines, where he indulges in an Indonesian dessert, the sweet Martabak, known as the "King of Street Food". (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Exploring The 'Wet Market' Of Nha Trang
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke hops on the train in Ga Thap Cham, and finds himself in Nha Trang—a region of Vietnam with a similar vibe to the French Riviera! Luke hand-catches seafood, looks for some fresh durian fruit, and visits a barramundi farm to harvest sea grapes! (Cooking) - 2020-02-24

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Fiery Chili Sauce in Hoi An
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke is in the town of Hội An. He visits a family who has been making chili sauce for 5 generations, stops by the Historic Japanese Covered Bridge built in 1719, and meets a 4th generation blacksmith who is creating knives from bombshells. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-03

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Seafood With A Bang, Here In Da Nang
tastemadetravel.us.description: On this stop of his Vietnam journey, Luke visits the bustling seaside city of Da Nang. Join him as he visits the spectacular Dragon Bridge, looks up some succulent shrimp on the beach, and stumbles upon a tiny fishing village packed with restaurants. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-10

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Savoury Vietnamese Pancakes in Huė
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke visits Huế - famous for its heritage and cuisine - and Con Hen Village to learn a technique for de-shelling baby clams, searches for best bowl of spicy beef noodle soup, and stops by a business where they make turmeric vermicelli noodle salad! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-17

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Chiles, Burgers, & Tenderloins in Santa Fe
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie heads to Santa Fe investigating New Mexican cuisines eating green chile burgers, poblano chile stews, and sweet blue-corn pancakes. (Cooking, Entertainment)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Pho, Poke, & Pig in O'ahu
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie explores Hawaii's O'ahu island to get nourished from fresh tuna poke, heartfelt Pho, and hand-pounded poi. (Cooking, Entertainment)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Quail, Alligator Sausage, & Gumbo in New Orleans
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie stops by New Orleans to chow down on lacquered quail, a beast of a Po Boy, and Creole Beef Daube. (Cooking, Entertainment)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Cubanos, Empanadas, & Smoked Beef Rib in Miami
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie goes to Miami to sample serious cherry smoked beef rib, three cheese spinach empanadas, and a legendary Cubano sandwich with homemade mustard. (Cooking, Entertainment)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Smash Burgers & A Slice in Los Angeles
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie Celenza heads to all the buzzworthy spots in LA - cooking up calamari steak at a classic Mexican joint, tasting taro root donuts with fun flavors, grabbing a guanciale slice, and hopping on the line to make cheesy scrumptious smash burgers. (Cooking, Travel) - 2023-09-06

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Heart of Tequila
tastemadetravel.us.description: Exploring the town of Tequila, Jalisco; the history of making tequila and a close up look at the process from the agave fields to the tasting table. (Cooking) - 2021-11-03

thestandupchannel.us.title: Tahir Moore: Aging Out

thestandupchannel.us.title: Denise Winkelman: Bougie on a Budget

afnsports.us.title: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt

classica.us.title: In der Probe: - Zubin Mehta
classica.us.description: Der indische Dirigent Zubin Mehta wurde 1977 Musikdirektor des Israel Philharmonic Orchestra und 1981 zum Musikdirektor auf Lebenszeit ernannt. Als einer der weltweit führenden Interpreten der großen symphonischen Literatur hat Mehta dieses beliebte Meisterwerk unzählige Male dirigiert, aber es war das erste Mal, dass er es von Grund auf einstudiert hat. Ein intimer Blick wird auf den Dialog zwischen Mehta und den Mitgliedern des Orchesters geworfen, während sie Strauss' Tondichtung proben. (Music) - 2000-04-02

10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E20 Haunted House Party Boo! The Bubble Guppies are invited to a costume party at a haunted house! They dress up as witches, vampires, werewolves, zombies and mummies, but who's that in the spooky ghost costume?

10shakeperth.au.title: Gabby's Dollhouse

10shakeperth.au.title: The Tiny Chef Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E7 Ice Cream / Pasta & Sauce Bonzo misses out on Chef's ice cream, so Chef cranks out more by hand. / Chef and Olly make fresh pasta, but Brody Bambino's sauce takes its time!

10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E4 One, Two, And Three! Margarita and Col learn with their teacher, gardener Tim, how to identify numbers one, two, and three. They count from 1 chair to 3 crayons, and more.

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S4 E15 The Flying Lion Blaze & AJ are excited to play with their new friend Roarian, the Flying Lion! But when Roarian loses his magical sunstone, he turns into a statue!

abcentertains.au.title: Submarine Jim - The Night Captain

abcentertains.au.title: Total Dramarama - Cone In 60 Seconds
abcentertains.au.description: After Owen gets ripped off at the ice cream truck the kids unite to right that wrong. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir - Gabriel Agreste

abcentertains.au.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu - Codename: Arcturus

abcentertains.au.description: Red and Blue meet Yellow and have fun colouring the seaside. Discover the colours around you with the Colourblocks. (Kids & Family)

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Torres Strait At Home

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Precious Flavours

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Jamie At Home
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S2 E4 Furred Game Most people think nothing of eating a chicken but what about a rabbit?

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Cheese Slices
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E1 Gorgonzola / Taleggio Under the spot light in this episode are gorgonzola and taleggio. Cheese authority Will Studd travels to Northern Italy to see how and where these fascinating cheeses are created.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E2 Comfort Food To start, we cook a breakfast of ginger bread pancakes with parma ham and maple syrup, then a warming prawn linguine with chorizo and cabernet tomato sauce.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice Of Italy

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Kriol Kitchen

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
